memory_candidates.content: In this .claude/ agent system, check-extension-docs.sh is itself a core provides.scripts entry, so any edit to it must be applied byte-identically to BOTH .claude/scripts/check-extension-docs.sh (deployed) and .claude/extensions/core/scripts/check-extension-docs.sh (source), or the #841 Rule F deployed-vs-source drift guard fails. Safest mechanism: edit the deployed copy first, verify with bash -n and a manual diff against the pre-edit source to confirm no other content differs, then `cp` the fully-edited deployed file over the source copy rather than hand-editing both independently — this guarantees byte-identity by construction instead of by double independent editing.

The recurring core doc-lint bug class in .claude/ is 'referenced-but-unpackaged script': a script exists deployed under .claude/scripts/ and is referenced by skills/agents/docs, but was never added to core's provides.scripts (or never backported into .claude/extensions/core/scripts/ as source-of-truth). Fix pattern (per task #793 precedent, reapplied by #843): copy deployed content into .claude/extensions/core/scripts/ FIRST via `cp` (never hand-edit — it's the sole in-use version), verify with diff -q, THEN register in provides.scripts. A manifest-only edit without the source backport trips a NEW 'manifest script entry missing on disk' FAIL.
